name: Shadow-Certified Threshold Recalibration v151
oracle_policy: realized outcomes are only used post-action for drift/shadow evaluation; no future outcome leakage into current action choice

policies.direct_predictive_recalibration: predictive drift detection then immediate threshold update
policies.shadow_certified_recalibration: predictive drift detection -> candidate threshold -> shadow replay -> temporary authority if certified

shadow_certification.accept_if: shadow candidate reduces realized lock-in score without reducing utility score by >0.01
shadow_certification.authority: temporary; revoke if later rolling score deteriorates
